authority.ratifier: Charlie Cheever, as the ratifying source named by LLP 0000

workload.scope: unchanged Partitime product fixture; v2 adds only the prospective memory and update-economy measurement profile
workload.randomization: literal-permutations-v1; no runtime shuffle or replacement

benchmarkControlApi.availability: benchmark build only; absent from ordinary production output

environment.power: AC power; Low Power Mode disabled; recorded by every receipt
environment.network: loopback-only deterministic Snapback backend; external network access is an invalid run
environment.browserIsolation: fresh browser context per cycle and unique user-data-dir per invocation

collector.memory: CDP HeapProfiler.collectGarbage followed immediately by Runtime.getHeapUsage.usedSize
collector.fanout: benchmark adapter count of logical subscription delivery callbacks caused by exactly one canonical server-authoritative update
collector.domPatches: MutationObserver record count caused by that update: each childList, attributes, or characterData record counts one; observer starts after warm stability and drains before the update
collector.stability: benchmark awaitStable succeeds, requested active-subscription count is exact, then three consecutive requestAnimationFrame turns produce no delivery callback and no MutationObserver record
collector.regression: nonnegative least squares y=intercept+slope*x; enumerate feasible unconstrained, intercept-zero, and slope-zero candidates and choose minimum SSE, breaking ties by lower slope then lower intercept

sampling.aggregation: nearest-rank p95 over seven retained valid cycle values (rank ceil(0.95*7)=7); equality passes
sampling.outlierPolicy: retain every valid sample; no trimming, winsorization, replacement, or post-observation exclusion
sampling.cycleLifecycle: fresh browser context, reset arm, execute the literal schedule, collect all counts, close context; warmups are retained but never enter targets or verdicts

metrics.cycleValue: nonnegative least-squares fixed intercept across all seven subscription counts
nonnegative least-squares slope across all seven subscription counts
logical delivery callbacks after one canonical update at exactly 8 active subscriptions
MutationObserver records after the same canonical update at exactly 8 active subscriptions

targetDerivation.rounding: integer floor after multiplication and before comparison
permittedInputs: react:snapback comparator samples collected under this protocol
forbiddenInputs: quick-run or calibration outcomes from the judged arm
targetDerivation.dependencyRule: the threshold receipt graph contains only protocol-constant and react-comparator ancestors; any direct or transitive judged-arm ancestor is a hard validation failure
targetDerivation.freezeRule: derive all five numeric targets, serialize canonical JSON, mint partitime-thresholds-v2-sha256-<first16>, commit it on a clean tree, then and only then permit the judged holdout

P0a.entry: the three authority amendments are content-bound and v1 remains unchanged
P0a.allowed: land and validate this preregistration, receipt schema, collector apparatus, and immutable pre-fix correctness evidence; governed post-fix Contract samples are forbidden
P0a.exit: protocol/schema/collector digests and the P0a entry receipt are committed and mirrored before the P0b repair merge

P0b.entry: a machine receipt binds the three amendments and complete P0a digest closure
P0b.allowed: merge the enumerated LLP 0381 correctness repair on correctness evidence only; historical and diagnostic performance observations remain non-normative
P0b.exit: correctness gates pass and no governed post-fix Contract performance sample exists

P0c.entry: P0b correctness is green and the tree is clean
P0c.allowed: collect React comparator cycles, derive and commit the threshold receipt, then unlock the untouched Contract holdout
P0c.exit: all five conjunctive metrics have complete raw receipts and the aggregate records an honest green or red verdict

invalidReasons: protocol, schema, collector, workload, or fixture identity mismatch
OS, hardware, memory, Chrome, Bun, power, or network identity mismatch
dirty source tree or unrecorded package identity
browser launch, CDP attach, fresh-context creation, or teardown failure
uncaught page error or browser process crash
benchmark control API missing or wrong method inventory
reset, stability, exact active-subscription count, or canonical update failure
garbage collection or heap read failure
delivery or MutationObserver counter missing, negative, non-integral, or contaminated by pre-update work
literal schedule, warmup count, sample count, or cycle completeness mismatch
P0c comparator collection after any governed judged-arm sample
holdout opened before the committed threshold-set identity exists
raw artifact, log, receipt, or dependency-graph digest mismatch
invalidRunPolicy.retention: retain the complete invalid receipt, raw observations, logs, reason code, and attempt ordinal; invalid observations never enter aggregation
invalidRunPolicy.retry: repeat only the complete invalid cycle under the identical protocol; never replace an individual count or cherry-pick a partial cycle
invalidRunPolicy.stopRule: after three invalid attempts for the same phase and arm, stop with a red instrument disposition; further attempts require the ratified invalidation or unavailability procedure
invalidRunPolicy.skipRule: a skip is never a pass and never enters aggregation
